package main

import "core:fmt"

/* outer /* nested */ still a comment */
Point :: struct {
	x: int,
	y: f64,
}

@(private)
square :: proc(x: int) -> int {
	return x * x
}

main :: proc() {
	name := "world"
	raw := `C:\temp\file`
	c: rune = 'x'
	count := 0x1F + 1_000
	#partial switch v in some_union {
	case int: fmt.println(v)
	}
	for i in 0..<3 {
		if i > 0 && c != '\n' {
			fmt.printf("Hello, %s! %d\n", name, square(i))
		}
	}
	defer delete(make([]int, 4))
	ptr: rawptr = nil
}
